about_the_game:
Create various items and weapons from a wide range of unique materials that can be gathered or found in different corners of the locations. Don’t forget to upgrade your workbench — it will allow you to craft cooler items with unique characteristics! However, not all items can be crafted right away; some require research or the creation of blueprints.

Your base is your only safe place, offering great opportunities for survival. Build and upgrade it to withstand the next attack from dangerous monsters without losing any ground. Strive to automate base defense and other processes as efficiently as possible, using electricity, as well as various devices and mechanisms. But remember, all of this requires constant monitoring and maintenance!

Explore numerous mysterious locations and objects to find and collect the most valuable items and resources. But stay alert: these locations hide many deadly dangers that lurk at every turn! Even places that seemed safe can suddenly become lethal!

Explore mysterious locations with your loyal friends, using voice chat to stay connected! Help each other on this challenging journey and try to return home together. And remember, teamwork is the key to your survival!

name: Shadow Of The Union

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600 / Intel Core i5-8250U or better
  • Memory: 10 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 / AMD 500 Series or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5500 / Intel Core i7-4790K or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060 / RX 570 Series or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 GB available space

short_description: Shadow of the Union is a cooperative game for 4 players, where you need to survive in a mysterious world full of dangers and monsters. Explore the world with your loyal companions, craft unique gear and weapons and prepare your base for the next attack of bloodthirsty monsters.
supported_languages:
English*, German*, Russian*
*languages with full audio support
